variation_policy: Batch variation is mandatory. Every item in a batch needs a different first sentence and a topic-specific consequence. Never copy a lead sentence across sibling records. Describe the application route in a record-specific form. Rotate paragraph, ordered list, checklist and short action plan formats, but keep the facts accurate. Preparation advice must come from the actual subject matter. Replace generic study slogans with a concrete task such as biology diagrams, timed quantitative sets, case-law reading or design observation. FAQ questions and answers must be unique across the batch. Ask about a decision that belongs to the individual exam or course, not a generic deadline question repeated everywhere. Never reuse these phrases: Roz thoda, same as above, use the official portal and current bulletin before payment. A template may control field shape, but it must not control wording, hook, FAQ phrasing, application explanation or preparation tip.
